## What's new

### Review replaces the Inbox

- **A full-screen Review screen** for work that Claude Code and Codex finish. Agents hand a task over with a summary, what was done and not done, how to check it, and screenshots. The task waits in Review instead of being marked done.
- **Accept or send it back.** Accept moves the task to Done and records which acceptance criteria are met. Anything not done can become a new task. Reject sends the task back to In progress with your comments, which the next agent sees first, and can open Claude Code or Codex with a fix prompt ready.
- **Agents' questions wait for you.** When an agent can't go on without you, its question waits at the top of Review and the task moves to Blocked. Questions agents ask in the chat are caught too, so nothing is lost when you aren't watching the terminal.
- Agent suggestions share the same timeline.
- New MCP tools for agents: `brain_submit_review` and `brain_ask_person`.

### Focus timer

- **An optional Pomodoro timer** (Settings → Focus timer), with 25/5, 40/10, 50/10, 52/17, 90/20 or your own minutes, a Home widget, and three sounds made for Moah. You can also use your own sound files.
- While the timer runs and Moah is minimized, a small oval in the corner shows the time left and how many items wait for review.
- On Linux with Wayland, Moah runs through XWayland while the timer is on, so turning it on asks for one restart.

### Easier to read and set up

- **Accessibility settings:** interface size from 90% to 200% (Automatic picks one from your screen), and a separate text size. Ctrl+Plus, Ctrl+Minus and Ctrl+0 work anywhere in the app.
- **A simpler Settings screen:** explanations sit under "?" buttons, and language and size settings are dropdowns. "Agents" is now "Connect agents".
- **A local error log** in Settings → Diagnostics, with copy and clear buttons. Errors from the app are kept in small files on your computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

### Fixes

- Agent sessions are matched to the right project more reliably: any folder linked to a project counts, another clone or worktree of the same repository matches, and a folder picked in the Flatpak file picker no longer makes a second project.
- The AI context page shows the real size of what agents receive.

### After updating

- Press **Connect** for Claude Code and Codex again (on Flatpak, run the command from Help) so agents get the new tools and the chat-question hooks. In Codex, trust the hooks once with `/hooks`.
